metadata.description: GAME MODE for Claude Code: an 8-bit look where every piece does a job (HUD, battle log, three guards, save point, sound cues)

plugins.name: game-hud
plugins.description: 8-bit HUD above the prompt: HP = context left, MP = plan usage left, G = session cost, rest/save buttons when HP runs low

plugins.name: game-battle-log
plugins.description: Tool rows as a battle log: HIT, CRIT, MISS with the lines that say what failed, BLOCK when a guard refused; failed groups unfold

plugins.name: game-trap-guard
plugins.description: Stops tool calls that would leak a secret: literal keys in commands or source files, cat .env, echo $API_KEY, reading key files

plugins.name: game-barrier
plugins.description: Stops irreversible calls: force-push to main, reset --hard, rm -r outside the project, publishing, DROP TABLE, edits outside the project

plugins.name: game-loop-breaker
plugins.description: Stops the same call failing the same way again and again: warns at LOOP 2/3, blocks once sealed, lifts after a change

plugins.name: game-save-point
plugins.description: /save writes an RPG save screen of the session; the next session offers its resume prompt on Tab

plugins.name: game-earcons
plugins.description: 8-bit sound cues: a prompt or question waiting on you, a long turn done, an error, a guard refusing, a save (macOS)
